title: Implement provider-neutral persistence adapter composition
businessObjective: Permit approved persistence-provider replacement without rewriting governed domain logic.
technicalObjective: Implement a deep `PersistencePort` composition boundary and deterministic reference adapters for local fixtures only; no provider account, database, migration, or production write.
assumptions: The first adapters are deterministic local/reference implementations and prove composition, not service connectivity.
acceptanceCriteria: Domain/application core depends on a small PersistencePort and imports no Cloudflare, Supabase, database, or local-server SDK.
Composition selects a reference adapter outside the core; unsupported/missing adapter configuration fails closed.
Persistence operations enforce P2-006 categories/retention references and P2-007 capacity decisions before acceptance.
Tests prove adapter substitution without domain rewrite, reject provider SDK imports in core, and reject unknown/over-budget writes.
No database, SQL, migration, account, credential, or network service is accessed.
allowedCommands: npm run verify:task -- --task SUT-AIOS-P3-004 --base origin/main --verifier-agent qa-verification --verifier-model gpt-5.6-sol --acceptance-confirmed
requiredChecks: exact validator admission before independent verification
solEscalationTriggers: Any database/provider SDK, schema migration, network call, retention deletion, or production persistence access.
rollbackExpectations: Revert the composition/reference implementation and preserve evidence; no external state exists.
